title: Large language models replicate and predict human cooperation across experiments in game theory

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM decision-making and cooperation rates in various game-theoretic scenarios (e.g., Prisoner's Dilemma, Snowdrift Game, Stag Hunt) against empirical human behavioral data and mathematical Nash equilibrium predictions to identify systematic deviations from human norms.

Evaluating whether models assume perfect rationality in themselves and opponents by measuring their alignment with theoretically optimal classical rational choice predictions (Nash equilibrium) rather than the bounded rationality typically exhibited by humans.
